content.comment_body: What is the maximum number of Hours Counters that can be used in a Circuit Diagram? I currently have four, but the tool menu for the LSC function is unavailable.
As far as I know, there's no set limit on the number of Hours Counters. The actual limit depends on how many blocks are still available and how much program memory remains.

I discovered that the reason I couldn't add any more Hours Counters was because I had used up my device's total REM allocation by selecting too many retentive options in other functions, such as counters and average calculations. Thanks for your help—hopefully this information will assist others, too.

analysis.insight_summary: The user struggled to add more Hours Counters in a circuit diagram using [company_name] hardware, mistakenly thinking there was a counter limit. The actual issue was limited REM allocation, used up by other retentive functions. This situation highlights confusion about resource allocation and unclear software feedback, as no explicit limit on counters exists.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates being able to use multiple Hours Counters unless a documented restriction applies and wants transparent communication when device resources are depleted.
